findings.location: Paragraph starting with "Avoid a luxurious life." (heading)
findings.suggested_fix: Use plural imperative consistent with the rest of the translation (vosotros form). Replace the heading text with: "Evitad una vida lujosa."

findings.location: Penultimate paragraph beginning "This is my last farewell..." (first sentence of that paragraph)
findings.source_quote: This is my last farewell, my dear lambs. always remember each other in love; diligently learn to read and write and obey everyone in that which is good.
findings.suggested_fix: Fix capitalization at the start of the second sentence. Change "recordad siempre los unos a los otros con amor;" to begin with an initial capital: "Recordad siempre los unos a los otros con amor;"
findings.translation_quote: Este es mi último adiós, mis queridos corderitos. recordad siempre los unos a los otros con amor; diligentemente aprendan a leer y escribir y obedeced a todos en lo que es bueno.
